10 استبعدهُ He reckoned it, or esteemed it, (namely, a thing, K, or a saying, A,) بَعِيد [i. e. distant, or remote; or if a saying or the like, far from being probable or correct, improbable, extraordinary, or strange]; (S, A, K;) as also ↓ ابعدهُ . (A.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, first sentence, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
